column3: ## Test Authenticated Navigation and Account Actions
Open the DOAJ homepage on the test server

column4: A "Login" link is displayed in the top-right corner

column3: Click "Login" and log in using the usual admin credentials

column4: The admin dashboard is displayed
The greeting "Hi, [username]!" is displayed in the top-left corner
No user tag is displayed above the greeting

column3: Inspect the primary black navigation bar

column4: The "Feature Tours" link is displayed and remains unchanged from the current live version
The "Notifications" link is displayed and remains unchanged from the current live version
The "System data" dropdown is displayed and remains unchanged from the current live version
The "Quick links" dropdown is displayed
The "Account actions" dropdown is displayed

column3: Open the "Quick links" dropdown by hovering over it

column4: A link to the "Admin dashboard" is displayed
A link to "DOAJ home" is displayed

column3: Open each link in the "Quick links" dropdown, returning to the dashboard after checking each destination

column4: The "Admin dashboard" link opens the admin dashboard
The "DOAJ home" link opens the DOAJ homepage

column3: Return to the admin dashboard and inspect the "Account actions" dropdown button

column4: The button displays "Signed in as [username] (admin)"
A "My account" link is displayed
A "Log out" button is displayed
The authenticated admin's account page is displayed

column3: Navigate to the DOAJ homepage while remaining logged in

column4: The secondary white navigation bar is displayed

column3: Open the "Dashboard" dropdown in the secondary white navigation bar

column4: The dashboard links available in the current live version are displayed
The "My account" link is not displayed

column3: Inspect the control next to the "Dashboard" dropdown

column4: An "Account actions" dropdown is displayed
The dropdown button displays "Signed in as [username] (admin)"
A "My account" link is displayed
A "Log out" button is displayed
The authenticated admin's account page is displayed

column3: Return to the DOAJ homepage, open the "Account actions" dropdown and click "Log out"

column4: The user is logged out
The DOAJ homepage is displayed
The "Login" link is displayed in the top-right corner
